text: Go outside or to the window and find 3 different leaves.
Find 5 objects at home that start with the letter C.
Measure the kitchen table with your own steps. How many steps is it?
Put an ice cube on a plate. How long does it take to melt?
Look for the Moon in the sky tonight. What shape is it?
At the supermarket, find something that costs less than 2€.
Sort the clean laundry socks by color.
Sit by the window for 5 minutes. How many birds can you see?
Pick a book and find 3 words you already know how to read.
Help fold 5 pieces of clothing.
Draw an animal that doesn't exist yet. Give it a name!
Do 10 jumps, then walk like a crab all the way to the door.
Run and find 3 red things at home.
Clap a rhythm with your hands. Can someone at home repeat it?
Build a paper or cardboard bridge between two chairs.
In the bath, find 3 objects that float and 3 that sink.
Ask a grandparent what games they played when they were little.
Pack your own school bag for tomorrow, all by yourself.
Prepare a simple snack (e.g. a sandwich) with an adult's help.
Help set the table and count how many spoons and forks are needed.
Plant a seed in a cup of soil and water it. Watch it every day.
Practice tying your shoelaces by yourself.
Lie on the grass or sit by the window and watch the clouds for 5 minutes. What shapes can you see?
With an adult near a street, count how many red cars pass by in 5 minutes.
Ask someone in your family to teach you one new word in a different language.
Make a paper airplane and test how far it can fly. Try to improve it!
With an adult, sort the household trash into the right recycling bins: paper, plastic and glass.
Write or draw a thank-you note for someone special and give it to them.
On a sunny day, trace the outline of your shadow on the ground with chalk. How does it change during the day?
On a walk, find signs or shop names with 5 different letters of the alphabet.
Count the coins you find in a piggy bank or drawer. How much money is that in total?
Jump rope 20 times in a row without stopping. Can you beat your record tomorrow?
With an adult's help, make a musical instrument out of a bottle and rice or beans.
Build the tallest tower you can with plastic cups. How many did you use?
Draw a treasure map of your house and hide a "treasure" for someone to find.
Help an adult prepare a simple recipe and count how many ingredients you used.
Imitate the sound and movement of 5 different animals. Can someone guess which ones they are?
